intent.rationale: op=3 is uncovered; simulation keeps the default alu_op=0 while synthesis treats the value as don't care.

labels.note: full_case on a case missing 2'b11 lets synthesis treat that value as don't-care despite the preceding default assignment.
alu_op is assigned before the case, so full_case has no effect and op=3 gives 0 in both simulation and synthesis.

settlement.note: The full_case case omits 2'b11, but alu_op gets a default (3'd0) before the case, so the pragma changes nothing: op=3 gives 0 in simulation and synthesis (convention 3).
